what: Clicking a same-site link makes three curved sheets, bulging in the middle, rise from the bottom of the screen at .15s intervals (.85s power3.inOut, curve ends flattening upward) to cover the screen, and navigation happens 1 second later. On the opened page, after .1s (phone 0) only the top sheet lifts upward in .65s with its bottom edge still bulging — a transition where color fills in like a wave. On phones (767 and below) the curve is shallower

options.cover: Time for one slide to fill in (s), default .85
options.wait: Time from press to navigating (s), default 1 — the original swup waits 1s for the body transition
options.reveal: Duration (s) for the top section to peel away on an open page, default .65
options.delay: Wait time (sec) before it clears on an open page, default .1 (0 on phone)
options.--fx-sheet-1 · 2 · 3 (style): Three slide colors — default soft accent · accent · contrast stage. The original mixes and picks from seven sets each time you advance
options.[data-fx-part=top] (on the link): Scrolls smoothly to the top without moving to another page

from.where: shared.js page transition (original TransitionView: swup 4.6.1 animation:out:start three paths M0 100V150Q50 50 100 150V100z → M0 100V0Q50 -1 100 0V100z, in:start top path .65s).
